description:
🛰️ SHE ORBITS

We are a 6-member research team taking on the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser! 

🌑 Team: Pouya, Larissa, Lucky, Sameera, Aparna & Pranjal. 

 We're creating an interactive web tool that computes Sun/Earth geometry ☀️, illumination & solar power potential ⚡, and direct-to-Earth communication windows 📡 for lunar south pole landing sites. It is powered by real NASA ephemeris & terrain data. 🎨 Looking for: UI/UX designers & web devs! 🚀
 🌙
